title: The Spectacular Rise and Fall of WeWork

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 DealBook 的商业和政策记者。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，与商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖进行现场对话，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻内容访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家锁定收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, it was the most valuable startup in the United States, with plans to revolutionize how and where people around the world worked.
sentences.zh: 今天，它曾是美国价值最高的初创公司，并计划彻底改变世界各地人们的工作方式和地点。

sentences.en: Amy chose it on the spectacular rise and fall of WeWork and the story of the man behind it all.
sentences.zh: 艾米选择了它，讲述 WeWork 惊人的崛起与陨落，以及幕后推手的故事。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月18日，星期一。

sentences.en: Amy, I wonder if you could read this letter that WeWork employees sent to their bosses.
sentences.zh: 艾米，我想请你读一下 WeWork 员工发给他们老板的这封信。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Here's what they wrote.
sentences.zh: 他们是这么写的。

sentences.en: To the WeCompany management team, WeWork's company values encourage us to be entrepreneurial, inspired, authentic, tenacious, grateful, and together.
sentences.zh: 致 WeCompany 管理团队：WeWork 的企业价值观鼓励我们具有企业家精神、充满灵感、保持真实、坚韧不拔、心怀感恩、团结一致。

sentences.en: Today, we are embracing these qualities wholeheartedly as we band together to ensure the well-being of our peers.
sentences.zh: 今天，当我们团结一心确保同伴的福祉时，我们正全心全意地拥抱这些品质。

sentences.en: Thousands of us will be laid off in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，我们当中将有数千人被裁员。

sentences.en: But we want our time here to have meant something.
sentences.zh: 但我们希望我们在这里的时光是有意义的。

sentences.en: We don't want to be defined by the scandals, the corruption, and the greed exhibited by the company's leadership.
sentences.zh: 我们不想被公司领导层表现出的丑闻、腐败和贪婪所定义。

sentences.en: We want to leave behind a legacy that represents the true character and intentions of WeWork employees.
sentences.zh: 我们想要留下能够代表 WeWork 员工真正品格和初心的遗产。

sentences.en: In the immediate term, we want those being laid off to be provided fair and reasonable separation terms
sentences.zh: 在近期，我们希望被裁员工能够获得公平合理的离职条款，

sentences.en: commensurate with their contributions, including severance pay, continuation of company paid health insurance, and compensation for lost equity.
sentences.zh: 与其贡献相匹配，包括遣散费、公司支付的健康保险延续以及对失去股权的补偿。

sentences.en: It's a pretty grim letter.
sentences.zh: 这是一封相当严峻的信。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So how did WeWork get to this point?
sentences.zh: 那么 WeWork 是怎么走到这一步的呢？

sentences.en: What's the story here?
sentences.zh: 这里面有什么故事？

sentences.en: Co-founder and CEO of WeWork, Adam Neumann.
sentences.zh: WeWork 联合创始人兼首席执行官亚当·纽曼。

sentences.en: So the story of WeWork really starts with a man named Adam Neumann.
sentences.zh: 所以 WeWork 的故事其实是从一个名叫亚当·纽曼的人开始的。

sentences.en: Growing up in Israel, watching American television and movies, I believed that the American dream is get a degree, get a great job, have lots of fun, make lots of money.
sentences.zh: 我在以色列长大，看着美国的电视和电影长大，我相信美国梦就是获得学位、找到好工作、尽情享乐、赚大钱。

sentences.en: He was born in Israel.
sentences.zh: 他出生于以色列。

sentences.en: He moved to New York.
sentences.zh: 他搬到了纽约。

sentences.en: I majored in entrepreneurship and marketing.
sentences.zh: 我的主修专业是创业学和市场营销。

sentences.en: And he started all of these sort of fly-by-night entrepreneurial ideas.
sentences.zh: 他开始搞所有这些昙花一现的创业点子。

sentences.en: One of them was...
sentences.zh: 其中一个是……

sentences.en: A genius idea was going to be a women's high-heeled shoe with a collapsible heel.
sentences.zh: 一个天才的想法是设计一款鞋跟可折叠的女式高跟鞋。

sentences.en: Women's high heels with collapsible heels.
sentences.zh: 带有可折叠鞋跟的女式高跟鞋。

sentences.en: Another was...
sentences.zh: 另一个是……

sentences.en: For a storage.
sentences.zh: 关于仓储的。

sentences.en: No, because it's uncomfortable, Michael, to walk around in heels all day.
sentences.zh: 不，迈克尔，因为整天穿着高跟鞋走路很不舒服。

sentences.en: So you collapse them when you're going down subway stairs.
sentences.zh: 所以当你走地铁楼梯时，你可以把鞋跟折叠起来。

sentences.en: And this is definitely not my passion.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是我的热情所在。

sentences.en: And I came up with my second great idea.
sentences.zh: 然后我想出了我的第二个伟大点子。

sentences.en: Crawlers with a cave.
sentences.zh: 带洞穴的爬行裤。

sentences.en: Crawlers was baby pants with knee pads on them to protect the baby's knees for the crawling age.
sentences.zh: 爬行裤是带有护膝的婴儿裤，在婴儿会爬的年龄保护他们的膝盖。

sentences.en: Knee pads for crawling babies.
sentences.zh: 给学步宝宝用的护膝。

sentences.en: The slogan was...
sentences.zh: 口号是……

sentences.en: Just because they don't tell you doesn't mean they don't hurt.
sentences.zh: 它们不告诉你，并不代表不疼。

sentences.en: Of course, the business was a tremendous failure.
sentences.zh: 当然，这项业务遭遇了巨大的失败。

sentences.en: So he settles on co-working.
sentences.zh: 于是他决定做联合办公。

sentences.en: And in 2010, started WeWork.
sentences.zh: 并在2010年创立了 WeWork。

sentences.en: WeWork is a leader in the business of renting out spaces to entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: WeWork 是向创业者出租办公空间业务的领头羊。

sentences.en: And it was a very specific time to be in the co-working business.
sentences.zh: 而且涉足联合办公业务正逢其时。

sentences.en: There were a lot of people who had a lot of startup ideas.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多人有很多创业点子。

sentences.en: Silicon Valley was booming.
sentences.zh: 硅谷正处于蓬勃发展期。

sentences.en: And you needed a place to work outside your parents' basement, right?
sentences.zh: 你需要一个能在父母地下室外面工作的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: It lets people rent out a desk or a private office equipped with amenities like internet, coffee, and spacious common areas.
sentences.zh: 它让人们能够租用配备了互联网、咖啡和宽敞公共区域等设施的办公桌或独立办公室。

sentences.en: They were sleek.
sentences.zh: 它们很时髦。

sentences.en: They had community space, sofas all over the place for team building.
sentences.zh: 它们有社区空间，到处都是用于团队建设的沙发。

sentences.en: There was cold brew, kombucha, taco Tuesdays.
sentences.zh: 有冷萃咖啡、康普茶、周二塔可之夜。

sentences.en: There was beer and wine on tap.
sentences.zh: 有生啤酒和葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Instead of going out for a drink, you'd stay at the office.
sentences.zh: 你不用出去喝酒，而是留在办公室。

sentences.en: It really came to symbolize the kind of startup entrepreneurial hustle of millennials.
sentences.zh: 它确实成为了千禧一代初创企业创业拼搏的象征。

sentences.en: In other words, this kind of space was perfectly timed for a generation of people who didn't see
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这种空间对于这样一代人来说出现得恰到好处，他们不把自己视为

sentences.en: themselves as office workers, but as individual businesses and entrepreneurs who needed a place to do that.
sentences.zh: 办公室职员，而是把自己视为需要一个地方来实现这一目标的个体商户和创业者。

sentences.en: WeWork is the office space of tomorrow.
sentences.zh: WeWork 是未来的办公空间。

sentences.en: The future is about light, innovation, creativity.
sentences.zh: 未来关乎光明、创新、创造力。

sentences.en: It's going from me to we.
sentences.zh: 这是从“我”走向“我们”。

sentences.en: We give you space that will inspire you, uplift you, and help you innovate the products of tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们为你提供能激发灵感、振奋精神并帮助你创新未来产品的空间。

sentences.en: So in Adam's mind, this was a community company.
sentences.zh: 所以在亚当的心目中，这是一个社区公司。

sentences.en: His mission was to elevate the world's consciousness.
sentences.zh: 他的使命是提升世界的意识。

sentences.en: He would talk about this.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈到这一点。

sentences.en: So he grew up partly on a kibbutz in Israel, and he would talk about it as a capitalist kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 他部分成长于以色列的一个基布兹，他常把它称为资本主义的基布兹。

sentences.en: It was this mix of like capitalistic hustle with this yearning for communal meaning.
sentences.zh: 这是资本主义拼搏精神与对社群意义的渴望的结合。

sentences.en: Adam Newman would say that he wanted WeWork to create a world where people don't just make a living, they make a life.
sentences.zh: 亚当·纽曼会说，他希望 WeWork 创造这样一个世界：人们不仅是在谋生，更是在创造生活。

sentences.en: And they make a life in these WeWork offices.
sentences.zh: 他们正是在这些 WeWork 办公室里创造生活。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The thing Adam Newman is really best at is communicating his vision, convincing people that he can change the way we work and live.
sentences.zh: 亚当·纽曼最擅长的事情就是传达他的愿景，说服人们他能够改变我们工作和生活的方式。

sentences.en: He fully adopted the persona of the Iconoclast startup founder, and he looks the part.
sentences.zh: 他完全采纳了反传统创业公司创始人的形象设定，并且外表也很符合。

sentences.en: You know, it's six foot five with flowing brown hair.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他身高六尺五寸（约1.96米），留着飘逸的棕色头发。

sentences.en: You know, people looked up to him when he walked in a meeting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他走进会议室时，人们都会仰视他。

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上的。

sentences.en: People literally paid attention to him.
sentences.zh: 人们真的是在注视着他。

sentences.en: But the most important person who bought into his vision is a Japanese executive, the head of a company called SoftBank.
sentences.zh: 但接受他愿景的最重要人物是一位日本高管，一家名为软银的公司的负责人。

sentences.en: The thing is, you know, I have a vision.
sentences.zh: 关键是，你知道，我有一个愿景。

sentences.en: Called Masayoshi-san.
sentences.zh: 被称为孙正义先生。

sentences.en: Everyone calls him Masa.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫他马萨（Masa）。

sentences.en: We go and change the world together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起去改变世界。

sentences.en: Masa's company oversees something called the Vision Fund.
sentences.zh: 马萨的公司管理着一个名为愿景基金的项目。

sentences.en: Thinking about what is the future, what is the, how we can change the life of people for the better humanity.
sentences.zh: 思考什么是未来，什么是，我们如何能为了人类更好地改变人们的生活。

sentences.en: This is the largest tech investment fund in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是全球最大的科技投资基金。

sentences.en: They have $100 billion to play with, largely from the Saudis who want to diversify away from oil and invest in tech.
sentences.zh: 他们有1000亿美元可以支配，主要来自希望摆脱对石油依赖并投资科技的沙特人。

sentences.en: And Masa is this very interesting character who's always trusted his gut.
sentences.zh: 马萨是一个非常有趣的人物，他总是相信自己的直觉。

sentences.en: One of the investments you made is considered by many people to be the most successful investment in the history of mankind.
sentences.zh: 你进行的一项投资被许多人认为是人类历史上最成功的投资。

sentences.en: You invested roughly $20 million in Alibaba.
sentences.zh: 你向阿里巴巴投资了大约2000万美元。

sentences.en: And at the time it went public, it was worth roughly $90 billion.
sentences.zh: 在它上市时，价值大约为900亿美元。

sentences.en: What is it that made you feel this was worth putting in $20 million?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你觉得这值得投入2000万美元？

sentences.en: Well, he had no business plan, but his eyes was very strong, strong eyes, strong, shining eyes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他没有商业计划，但他的眼神非常坚定，坚定的眼神，坚定的、闪烁的眼神。

sentences.en: And so he meets Adam Neumann.
sentences.zh: 于是他遇到了亚当·纽曼。

sentences.en: Adam Neumann gives Masa a tour of his offices.
sentences.zh: 亚当·纽曼带马萨参观了他的办公室。

sentences.en: This includes the right soundtrack in the background and all the sleek office space and virtual reality renderings of
sentences.zh: 这包括背景音乐以及所有时尚的办公空间和虚拟现实渲染图，

sentences.en: WeWork office space in the future.
sentences.zh: 展示了未来的 WeWork 办公空间。

sentences.en: So you could wear these glasses and feel like you're standing in
sentences.zh: 所以你可以戴上这些眼镜，感觉自己正站在

sentences.en: Tokyo or Shanghai, right down to looking out the street and seeing the scene that you would see from the offices.
sentences.zh: 东京或上海，甚至能看到街道上的景象，就像你从办公室看出去的一样。

sentences.en: And this really blows Masa's mind.
sentences.zh: 这确实让马萨大开眼界。

sentences.en: He loves this vision.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢这个愿景。

sentences.en: He loves Adam's energy.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢亚当的活力。

sentences.en: You know, both WeWork and SoftBank Vision Fund are shoot the moon operations.
sentences.zh: 你知道，WeWork 和软银愿景基金都是雄心勃勃、孤注一掷的运作。

sentences.en: So after a 12-minute tour of the WeWork offices and Adam Neumann's vision...
sentences.zh: 所以在对 WeWork 办公室和亚当·纽曼愿景进行了12分钟的参观之后……

sentences.en: Basically both willing to make humongous bets and they're sort of, you know, enabling one another.
sentences.zh: 基本上双方都愿意下巨额赌注，而且他们某种程度上，你知道，在互相赋能。

sentences.en: Masa-san invests over $4 billion in WeWork.
sentences.zh: 马萨先生向 WeWork 投资了超过40亿美元。

sentences.en: And by the way, I work in a WeWork, so WeWorks are good.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我在 WeWork 工作，所以 WeWork 很不错。

sentences.en: I hear they have good drinks on tap, David.
sentences.zh: 我听说他们有很好的生啤酒，大卫。

sentences.en: This is an enormous investment.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔巨额投资。

sentences.en: And he doesn't say, Adam, I need you to be a very careful steward of this extremely important investment.
sentences.zh: 而且他并没有说，亚当，我需要你成为这个极其重要的投资项目的极其谨慎的管家。

sentences.en: Be careful with my money.
sentences.zh: 小心对待我的钱。

sentences.en: Instead, he says, I need you to go crazier.
sentences.zh: 相反，他说，我需要你更疯狂一点。

sentences.en: I need you to do more.
sentences.zh: 我需要你做更多的事情。

sentences.en: I need you to explore your wildest visions.
sentences.zh: 我需要你去探索你最疯狂的愿景。

sentences.en: He says that.
sentences.zh: 他是这么说的。

sentences.en: He says, go as far as you can with this.
sentences.zh: 他说，带着这个去走得越远越好。

sentences.en: And there's more money where this came from.
sentences.zh: 而且资金还多得很。

sentences.en: So just how wild does Adam Neumann go with this $4 billion investment?
sentences.zh: 那么亚当·纽曼带着这40亿美元的投资到底能有多疯狂？

sentences.en: So we're at WeWork in Austin, Texas right now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的 WeWork。

sentences.en: He started opening WeWorks all over the country.
sentences.zh: 他开始在全国各地开设 WeWork。

sentences.en: My new office at the Crystal City WeWork that just opened up today.
sentences.zh: 我在今天刚刚开业的水晶城 WeWork 的新办公室。

sentences.en: Every major American city had a WeWork.
sentences.zh: 美国每个主要城市都有一个 WeWork。

sentences.en: My new office space, which is in the WeWork in Long Beach, California.
sentences.zh: 我的新办公空间，位于加利福尼亚州长滩的 WeWork 内。

sentences.en: And then he expanded massively abroad.
sentences.zh: 然后他在海外进行了大规模扩张。

sentences.en: I feel like I remember this moment because I woke up one day and had a long walk around Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我还记得那个时刻，因为有一天我醒来，在曼哈顿漫步了很久。

sentences.en: And there was a WeWork at every single turn.
sentences.zh: 转角到处都是 WeWork。

sentences.en: The Lerman Taylor building.
sentences.zh: 勒曼泰勒大楼。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: They became ubiquitous.
sentences.zh: 它们变得无处不在。

sentences.en: WeWork now has 45 million square feet of real estate.
sentences.zh: WeWork 现在拥有4500万平方英尺的房地产。

sentences.en: It's the largest private landlord in New York, Washington, and London.
sentences.zh: 它是纽约、华盛顿和伦敦最大的私人房东。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then giant companies started also moving their employees into WeWork offices, thinking it's a draw for employees to work in these spaces.
sentences.zh: 然后大公司也开始将他们的员工搬进 WeWork 办公室，认为在这些空间工作对员工很有吸引力。

sentences.en: Like which companies?
sentences.zh: 比如哪些公司？

sentences.en: Verizon, Salesforce, IBM all moved a lot of employees into WeWork office spaces.
sentences.zh: 威瑞森、赛富时、IBM 都将大量员工搬进了 WeWork 办公空间。

sentences.en: This is the point when Adam really leans into Moss's advice, which is to go wild, pursue your craziest dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 这就是亚当真正倾听马萨建议的时刻，那就是疯狂行事，追求你最疯狂的梦想。

sentences.en: He opens a WeLive apartment building and wants to expand that.
sentences.zh: 他开设了一栋 WeLive 公寓楼，并希望将其扩大规模。

sentences.en: He says these are places that will have community and cut down on the suicide rate because people never feel alone.
sentences.zh: 他说这些地方将拥有社区感并降低自杀率，因为人们永远不会感到孤独。

sentences.en: He was talking about WeGrow and he and his wife opened a school in downtown Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 他当时在谈论 WeGrow，他和妻子在曼哈顿市中心开办了一所学校。

sentences.en: There was WeBank.
sentences.zh: 还有 WeBank。

sentences.en: There was WeSail.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，有WeSail。

sentences.en: There was WeSleep.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，有WeSleep。

sentences.en: There was talk of an airline.
sentences.zh: 当时甚至还有人提到过要开办一家航空公司。

sentences.en: WeFly?
sentences.zh: WeFly？

sentences.en: WeFly, presumably.
sentences.zh: 大概叫WeFly吧。

sentences.en: There was talk of WeMars, even putting office space on the red planet.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有人提到过WeMars，要把办公空间搬到红色星球上去。

sentences.en: That really is wild.
sentences.zh: 那确实太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It was wild.
sentences.zh: 确实很疯狂。

sentences.en: So Adam Neumann becomes fantastically rich.
sentences.zh: 于是，亚当·纽曼变得富可敌国。

sentences.en: He also indulges his eccentricities.
sentences.zh: 他也开始纵容自己的古怪行径。

sentences.en: I mean, he was known to walk around the office barefoot, but now he's installed a private plunge pool in his office, a cold plunge, an infrared sauna in his office.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他以前就喜欢赤脚在办公室里走来走去，但现在他直接在办公室里安了一个私人冷水浸泡池，还有一个红外线桑拿房。

sentences.en: He has a white Maybach.
sentences.zh: 他有一辆白色的迈巴赫。

sentences.en: He's like glaring hip hop as this chauffeured white Maybach takes him all over Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 当这辆有专职司机的白色迈巴赫载着他穿梭于曼哈顿各地时，他总是放着震耳欲聋的嘻哈音乐。

sentences.en: He also convinced the company to buy a $60 million private plane, which he and other executives hotbox.
sentences.zh: 他还说服公司买了一架价值6000万美元的私人飞机，他和别的公司高管经常在里面闷头抽大麻。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: That's, you know, getting high in a confined space with the marijuana smoke filling the cabin.
sentences.zh: 也就是你知道的那种，在狭小的空间里吸毒，大麻烟雾充满整个客舱。

sentences.en: Tequila.
sentences.zh: 龙舌兰。

sentences.en: Adam Neumann loved his Don Julio tequila.
sentences.zh: 亚当·纽曼对他的唐·胡里奥龙舌兰爱不释手。

sentences.en: He would even get people who didn't seem the tequila type, like Jared Kushner, to take tequila shots at nine in the morning while they were scoping out some real estate in Philly.
sentences.zh: 他甚至会拉那些看起来根本不喝龙舌兰的人（比如杰瑞德·库什纳），让他们在早上九点一边在费城考察房地产，一边干杯龙舌兰酒。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇哦。

sentences.en: But employees said that there was just free flowing booze all the time.
sentences.zh: 但员工们表示，公司里酒水随时无限畅饮。

sentences.en: A lot of marijuana, a lot of these summer camp kind of weekend retreats.
sentences.zh: 大量的大麻，还有很多那种夏令营风格的周末静修活动。

sentences.en: People would get drunk and they'd dance around a fire singing to Journey and other sort of animal house antics, but always infused with this like larger purpose.
sentences.zh: 大家喝得酩酊大醉，围着篝火跳舞，听着Journey乐队的歌唱，还有其他各种类似于《动物屋》的恶作剧，但总是被灌输着某种宏大的目标感。

sentences.en: Adam would get on stage with like Deepak Chopra and address employees.
sentences.zh: 亚当会和迪帕克·乔普拉之类的人物一起登台向员工发表讲话。

sentences.en: And it was this culture of WeWork that was very specific to kind of Adam's vision for the company.
sentences.zh: 这就是WeWork的文化，带有非常鲜明的亚当对公司的愿景。

sentences.en: So, Amy, as Adam Neumann becomes this large human life character, as WeWork is opening offices all over the United States, all over the world,
sentences.zh: 那么，艾米，随着亚当·纽曼成为这样一个传奇般的人物，随着WeWork在全美乃至全球各地开设办公室，

sentences.en: and as this term we starts to get applied to all areas of life,
sentences.zh: 随着“We”这个词开始被应用到生活的方方面面，

sentences.en: are people starting to question whether this is getting just a little too big and whether it's all kind of adding up?
sentences.zh: 人们是否开始质疑，这一切是不是变得有点太大了，而且这一切到底有没有实际意义？

sentences.en: By and large, people looked at what Adam had accomplished.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，人们看到了亚当所取得的成就。

sentences.en: WeWork on every corner, as you said, taking over iconic buildings, and they believed in what he was selling.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，WeWork开遍了每一个街角，接管了标志性的建筑，他们相信他所兜售的东西。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, you throw in Masa, this Japanese tycoon who had made a fortune investing early on in these founders, Alibaba, Yahoo, Uber, just based on gut instinct.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，你还得算上孙正义，这位日本大亨凭直觉早期投资了这些创始人，比如阿里巴巴、雅虎、Uber，从而赚取了巨额财富。

sentences.en: And if he believed in Adam, why shouldn't everyone else?
sentences.zh: 如果他都信任亚当，其他人又有什么理由不呢？

sentences.en: So WeWork does what successful startups do.
sentences.zh: 所以，WeWork做着所有成功初创企业都会做的事。

sentences.en: They prepare to go public, meaning they can sell their shares to the public.
sentences.zh: 他们准备上市，这意味着他们可以向公众出售股份。

sentences.en: There's a valuation on the company of $47 billion.
sentences.zh: 公司的估值达到了470亿美元。

sentences.en: That makes it the most valuable startup in the country.
sentences.zh: 这使其成为全美最有价值的初创公司。

sentences.en: And part of going public, they have to disclose everything in paperwork.
sentences.zh: 作为上市流程的一部分，他们必须在文书工作中披露所有信息。

sentences.en: And that's when things start to unravel.
sentences.zh: 也就是在这个时候，事情开始败露了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: WeWork just unveiling its IPO filing.
sentences.zh: WeWork刚刚公布了其IPO招股说明书。

sentences.en: So why do things start to unravel when WeWork files off its paperwork to go public?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么当WeWork提交上市文件时，事情会开始败露呢？

sentences.en: So this is the first time that journalists, investors, the public can really look under the hood at what's going on in WeWork.
sentences.zh: 这是记者、投资者和公众第一次能够真正一探究竟，看看WeWork内部到底在发生什么。

sentences.en: Do we have any numbers in terms of how much money they're making or losing right now?
sentences.zh: 我们有没有关于他们目前盈利或亏损多少的数据？

sentences.en: And it's not pretty.
sentences.zh: 结果很不容乐观。

sentences.en: Net losses were just under a billion dollars, $904 million.
sentences.zh: 净亏损略低于10亿美元，达到了9.04亿美元。

sentences.en: The company had lost $900 million in the first half of 2019 alone.
sentences.zh: 仅在2019年上半年，该公司就亏损了9亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇哦。

sentences.en: They had rapidly expanded into markets that weren't necessarily friendly to WeWork.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速扩张到那些对WeWork未必友好的市场。

sentences.en: And there had also been some kind of questionable financial dealings between Adam and the company that he started.
sentences.zh: 亚当和由他创立的公司之间，还存在一些令人起疑的金融交易。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: Well, he had trademarked the word we and sold it back to the company for $5.9 million.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他注册了“we”这个词的商标，然后以590万美元的价格卖回给了公司。

sentences.en: He ended up returning that money.
sentences.zh: 他最终把这笔钱退了回去。

sentences.en: But that certainly raised eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 但这无疑让人侧目。

sentences.en: He had bought a lot of the buildings that WeWork was now leasing.
sentences.zh: 他买下了许多WeWork现在正在租赁的建筑。

sentences.en: So the company had paid him millions of dollars for space in the offices that he owned.
sentences.zh: 因此，公司为了他名下办公室的空间，已经支付给他数百万美元。

sentences.en: So this is all very unconventional and potentially even self-dealing.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都非常不合常规，甚至可能存在利益输送。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then there's the text of the IPO, the legal document that they filed with the SEC.
sentences.zh: 但随后还有IPO的正文，也就是他们提交给美国证券交易委员会的法律文件。

sentences.en: The word community is listed more than 150 times.
sentences.zh: “社区”这个词出现了150多次。

sentences.en: And there was all of this kind of propping up what we now know is a very unprofitable business with this lingo of self-help and creating community.
sentences.zh: 所有这些自助和创建社区的行话，都在粉饰我们现在所知道的一个极度亏损的业务。

sentences.en: And people just started to see it as selling air, you know, couching this unprofitable business in language that made people feel good.
sentences.zh: 人们开始认为这纯粹是在贩卖空气，你知道的，用让人感觉良好的语言来包装这个亏损的业务。

sentences.en: So this paperwork filed with the SEC really sets off an implosion unlike any other in startup history.
sentences.zh: 因此，向美国证券交易委员会提交的这份文件，真正引发了一场初创企业史上前所未有的内爆。

sentences.en: All the bad press and the bad moves caused the company's expected valuation to drop from $47 billion down to just $15 billion.
sentences.zh: 所有的负面报道和糟糕的举措导致公司的预期估值从470亿美元暴跌至仅150亿美元。

sentences.en: It could come in as low as $10 billion.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能低至100亿美元。

sentences.en: According to the office-sharing company, below $8 billion.
sentences.zh: 据这家共享办公公司称，甚至低于80亿美元。

sentences.en: And that is a fraction of the $47 billion.
sentences.zh: 这与470亿美元相比只是九牛一毛。

sentences.en: The value of WeWork plummets.
sentences.zh: WeWork的估值一落千丈。

sentences.en: So this is when discussion starts to spread of, well, should there even be an IPO?
sentences.zh: 于是，各种讨论开始蔓延：好了，到底还要不要搞IPO？

sentences.en: Is this company ready to go public?
sentences.zh: 这家公司真的准备好上市了吗？

sentences.en: And people start to turn on Adam pretty quickly at this point.
sentences.zh: 就在这个时候，人们开始迅速调转枪头对付亚当。

sentences.en: WeWork CEO Adam Neumann is facing new pressure from some of his top investors following the company's decision to postpone the IPO.
sentences.zh: 在公司决定推迟IPO后，WeWork首席执行官亚当·纽曼正面临来自一些顶级投资者的新压力。

sentences.en: Some board members and large investors in the company are privately discussing whether they could replace CEO Adam Neumann and how they would do it.
sentences.zh: 公司的一些董事会成员和主要投资者正在私下讨论是否可以撤换首席执行官亚当·纽曼以及他们将如何做到这一点。

sentences.en: They think he should be removed.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他应该被解雇。

sentences.en: He should not be the CEO of WeWork.
sentences.zh: 他不应该再担任WeWork的首席执行官。

sentences.en: Not only should he not be the CEO, but he should have no involvement in WeWork anymore.
sentences.zh: 他不仅不应该担任首席执行官，而且不应该再参与WeWork的任何事务。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is now official.
sentences.zh: 是的，现在这已经是官方消息了。

sentences.en: WeWork has officially come out saying that Adam Neumann is stepping down as CEO.
sentences.zh: WeWork已正式宣布亚当·纽曼将卸任首席执行官一职。

sentences.en: Eventually, Adam is forced to step down.
sentences.zh: 最终，亚当被迫辞职。

sentences.en: People are supposed to say, I hate to be and I told you so, but I love to be and I told you so.
sentences.zh: 人们总说，我讨厌说“我早就告诉你了”，但我其实最喜欢说“我早就告诉你了”。

sentences.en: This house of cards was coming down.
sentences.zh: 这座纸牌屋正在坍塌。

sentences.en: This business based on beanbags, distressed furniture, and Nespresso machines.
sentences.zh: 这项基于懒人沙发、破旧家具和浓缩咖啡机的业务。

sentences.en: And yet somehow this guy has been treated as some guru genius because he's such an effective self-promoter.
sentences.zh: 然而不知何故，这家伙一直被当作某种大师级天才对待，因为他太擅长自我宣传了。

sentences.en: P.T.
sentences.zh: 据说P·T·

sentences.en: Barnum is supposed to have said there's a sucker born every minute.
sentences.zh: 巴纳姆曾说过，世上 Sucker 源源不断。

sentences.en: That's what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 现在情况就是这样。

sentences.en: And Wall Street, they were suckered too, along with SoftBank buying in.
sentences.zh: 华尔街也被忽悠了，还有软银也跟着投资了。

sentences.en: Where did they get this $47 billion for $12 billion in cash?
sentences.zh: 他们从120亿美元的现金里，究竟上哪儿弄来这470亿美元的估值？

sentences.en: So they decide that even getting rid of Adam does not save this effort to go public, and they have to pull the IPO.
sentences.zh: 因此他们断定，即使赶走亚当也无法拯救这次上市计划，他们不得不取消IPO。

sentences.en: I mean, this is hugely embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太尴尬了。

sentences.en: This company that had been valued at $47 billion, most valuable startup in the country, is suddenly valued at a tiny fraction of that.
sentences.zh: 这家曾被估值470亿美元、全美最有价值的初创公司，转眼间估值只剩下区区一小部分。

sentences.en: And this Japanese investor, Masa-san, who had been such a visionary, it's extremely embarrassing for him.
sentences.zh: 而这位曾被视为远见卓识的日本投资者马萨桑（Masa-san），对此感到极其尴尬。

sentences.en: Ultimately, he has to apologize to investors specifically for putting so much faith in Adam Neumann.
sentences.zh: 最终，他不得不向投资者道歉，特别是为自己对亚当·纽曼寄予了如此多的信任而道歉。

sentences.en: So what becomes of Adam Neumann at this point?
sentences.zh: 那么亚当·纽曼现在结局如何？

sentences.en: He has been pushed out of his company.
sentences.zh: 他已经被挤出了自己的公司。

sentences.en: In a way, he has been exposed as someone who is a better salesman than operator of a company.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，他被曝光其实是个更擅长销售而非运营公司的人。

sentences.en: And it becomes pretty clear that he has built something that is not all that revolutionary, but is a little bit of a financial house of cards.
sentences.zh: 而且很明显，他建立的并不是什么具有革新意义的东西，而是一座稍显脆弱的财务纸牌屋。

sentences.en: Well, here's what's so interesting about what happened to Adam Neumann.
sentences.zh: 好了，亚当·纽曼身上的经历最有趣的地方在于：

sentences.en: He walked away from the company he founded with over a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 他带着超过10亿美元离开了自己创立的公司。

sentences.en: How is that possible?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能？

sentences.en: SoftBank bought his shares in WeWork, and they also agreed to pay him $46 million in consulting fees for four years.
sentences.zh: 软银买下了他在WeWork的股份，并且还同意在四年内向他支付4600万美元的咨询费。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇哦。

sentences.en: Nice work if you can get it.
sentences.zh: 要是能拿到这笔钱，这活儿可真不错。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: SoftBank would say that this was the cost to get Adam out and start to clean up the mess, which includes laying off potentially thousands of employees.
sentences.zh: 软银会说，这是让亚当出局并开始清理烂摊子的代价，其中包括可能裁员数千名员工。

sentences.en: You know, in this letter, the employees call it graft.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在这封信里，员工们称之为搜刮民脂民膏。

sentences.en: Here he was walking away with over a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 他居然带着十多亿美元拍屁股走人。

sentences.en: I mean, generational wealth as they face layoffs, losing their health care, getting nothing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当员工们面临裁员、失去医保、一无所有时，他却赚到了几代人都花不完的财富。

sentences.en: They write, We are not the Adam Neumanns of this world.
sentences.zh: 他们写道：“我们不是这个世界的亚当·纽曼。”

sentences.en: We are a diverse workforce with rents to pay, households to support, and children to raise.
sentences.zh: “我们是一个多元化的员工群体，我们要付房租、要养家糊口、要把孩子抚养长大。”

sentences.en: We are not asking for this level of graft.
sentences.zh: “我们没有要求这种级别的搜刮。”

sentences.en: We are asking to be treated with humanity and dignity so we can continue living life while searching to make a living elsewhere.
sentences.zh: “我们只要求得到人性和尊严的对待，这样我们才能在寻找其他生计的同时继续生活下去。”

sentences.en: Amy, how do we explain what's happened here, the pretty sad saga of WeWork and the situation that has ended with all these workers waiting to be laid off?
sentences.zh: 艾米，我们该如何解释这里发生的一切？WeWork这场相当悲惨的闹剧，以及最终导致所有这些员工等待被裁的局面？

sentences.en: So the story of WeWork and Adam Neumann is essentially a story of his exploitation of two phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 所以，WeWork和亚当·纽曼的故事，本质上是他对两种现象的剥削利用史。

sentences.en: The first is this kind of late-stage tech capitalism when investors really want to believe in these startup founders who have businesses that are essentially sort of traditional businesses with tech layered on.
sentences.zh: 首先是这种晚期科技资本主义，当时投资者非常愿意相信那些初创公司创始人，他们的业务本质上其实是传统业务，只是套上了科技的外衣。

sentences.en: Uber is a perfect example of that.
sentences.zh: Uber就是完美的例子。

sentences.en: Calling a taxi with your phone.
sentences.zh: 用手机叫辆出租车。

sentences.en: And in turn, give these companies enormous valuations when the business underpinnings are not necessarily there.
sentences.zh: 反过来，当业务基础根本不存在时，却给这些公司荒谬绝伦的高估值。

sentences.en: So the irony, of course, was that Adam Neumann tapped into this tech vernacular about changing the world, about revolutionizing office space.
sentences.zh: 所以，最讽刺的是，亚当·纽曼借用了这种关于改变世界、革新办公空间的科技黑话。

sentences.en: But his company had really nothing to do with tech.
sentences.zh: 但他的公司实际上与科技毫无关系。

sentences.en: It was a commercial real estate company.
sentences.zh: 它是一家商业房地产公司。

sentences.en: But people believed that.
sentences.zh: 但人们相信了这一点。

sentences.en: But it had a tech valuation because investors believed it.
sentences.zh: 因为投资者相信，所以它获得了科技公司的估值。

sentences.en: The second thing he quite brilliantly exploited was this yearning of millennials having this capitalist ambition and hustle, but also this yearning for community,
sentences.zh: 他巧妙利用的第二点，是千禧一代对资本主义雄心和奋斗的渴望，以及他们对社区的渴望，

sentences.en: this we generation, as he called it, that it's not about you or me, it's about we.
sentences.zh: 也就是他所谓的“We一代”，这不是关于你或我，而是关于我们。

sentences.en: And in the end, it essentially was about him.
sentences.zh: 到头来，这一切本质上还是为了他自己。

sentences.en: It is us who will blaze a path forward, paved not with algorithms, not with software, but with values, with friendship, with common goals, and most importantly, with humanity.
sentences.zh: 正是我们开辟了前进的道路，这条道路不是用算法铺就的，不是用软件铺就的，而是用价值观、用友谊、用共同的目标，最重要的是，用人性铺就的。

sentences.en: And I think that's been particularly hard for WeWork employees to stomach.
sentences.zh: 我想，对于WeWork的员工来说，这一点尤其难以接受。

sentences.en: It's not just that the business turned out to be not as profitable as they thought it was and their CEO walked away with a giant golden parachute.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为事实证明这项业务并没有他们想象的那么赚钱，而且他们的首席执行官还带着巨大的金色降落伞全身而退。

sentences.en: It was that they believed that it was bigger than that.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们曾相信这件事意义更宏大。

sentences.en: They believed it was a community.
sentences.zh: 他们曾相信这是一个社区。

sentences.en: And now they're saying that it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们却说，根本不是这回事。

sentences.en: And the We revolution is going to be led by the We generation.
sentences.zh: We革命将由We一代来领导。

sentences.en: And it will restore in each one of us a sense of dignity and community without which greatness cannot be achieved.
sentences.zh: 它将在我们每个人心中恢复尊严感和社区感，没有这些，就无法成就伟大。

sentences.en: The We generation knows that you must treat other people.
sentences.zh: We一代深知你必须如何对待他人。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, the Times reported that WeWork is preparing to lay off at least 4,000 employees.
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，《时报》报道称WeWork正准备裁员至少4000人。

sentences.en: Those layoffs are expected to be announced as early as this week.
sentences.zh: 这些裁员预计最早将于本周宣布。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, impeachment investigators released the closed-door testimony of a National Security Council official,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，弹劾调查人员公布了一名国家安全委员会官员的闭门证词，

sentences.en: Tim Morrison, who further tied President Trump to the quid pro quo with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·莫里森（Tim Morrison），他进一步将特朗普总统与乌克兰的利益交换丑闻联系在了一起。

sentences.en: Morrison testified that Gordon Sondland, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 莫里森在证词中表示，美国驻欧盟大使戈登·桑德兰（Gordon Sondland）

sentences.en: ambassador to the European Union,
sentences.zh: 美国驻欧盟大使

sentences.en: acted at Trump's behest when he repeatedly communicated to Ukrainian officials that opening investigations helpful to Trump would result in the release of $400 million in U.S.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的授意下，多次向乌克兰官员传达：只要展开对特朗普有利的调查，就能发放被特朗普扣押的

sentences.en: military assistance to Ukraine, withheld by Trump.
sentences.zh: 4亿美元对乌军事援助。

sentences.en: Morrison also testified that National Security Advisor John Bolton had tried and failed to convince
sentences.zh: 莫森还作证说，国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿曾在夏天的一次会议上

sentences.en: Trump to release the military assistance during a meeting over the summer.
sentences.zh: 试图说服特朗普释放军事援助，但没有成功。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Great night it is for Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 对路易斯安那州来说，这是一个美妙的夜晚。

sentences.en: And to God be the glory.
sentences.zh: 一切荣耀归于上帝。

sentences.en: Governor John Bel Edwards of Louisiana, the only Democratic governor in the Deep South, narrowly won re-election on Saturday, defeating a Republican supported by President Trump.
sentences.zh: 路易斯安那州长约翰·贝尔·爱德华兹——美国深南部唯一的民主党州长——于周六险胜连任，击败了一位得到特朗普总统支持的共和党人。

sentences.en: It was the second time in two weeks that a Republican candidate for governor backed by Trump has been defeated.
sentences.zh: 这是两周内第二位得到特朗普支持的共和党州长候选人落败。

sentences.en: After the defeat of Kentucky's Republican governor, Trump had told Louisiana voters that he needed them to deliver him a victory.
sentences.zh: 在肯塔基州共和党州长落败后，特朗普曾对路易斯安那州的选民说，他需要他们为他带来一场胜利。

sentences.en: So Trump took a call, so you've got to give me a big win, please, okay?
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普接了个电话，所以你得给我一个大胜，求你了，好吗？

sentences.en: On Saturday, during his victory speech, Louisiana's governor gently teased Trump about the outcome.
sentences.zh: 周六，在胜选演讲中，路易斯安那州州长温和地拿这个结果调侃了特朗普。

sentences.en: And as for the president, God bless his heart.
sentences.zh: 至于总统嘛，愿上帝保佑他。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》节目到此结束。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台管控严密的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·凯尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
